business_problem: BNP Paribas Cardif handles more than 20 million customer phone calls each year, but manual review was too limited and slow to extract actionable insight from conversations for service improvement, product fit checks, and customer journey optimization.
solution_summary: BNP Paribas Cardif built an in-house AI solution called Call Analyzer to industrialize analysis of customer phone conversations. The implementation starts with call audio files sent to the application through an API. Call Analyzer uses speech-to-text AI models to transcribe recordings into text, then applies AI analysis to the transcripts to examine vocabulary, speech speed, lexical field, and other conversation signals. The processed outputs are converted into statistics and verbatim comments that feed dashboards in data visualization tools. Those dashboards are consumed by marketing and customer operations teams to monitor KPIs, identify service issues, refine telephone insurance subscription processes, and assess whether products sold over the phone match customer needs. The platform is already operating across several Latin American countries and is being deployed more broadly in Europe, with newer generative AI capabilities now added to deepen analysis.

The system then analyzes transcript content such as vocabulary, speech speed, and lexical field, and turns the results into statistics and verbatim comments that are surfaced in dashboards for marketing and customer operations teams.
business_outcome: The solution enables faster, broader analysis of customer conversations so BNP Paribas Cardif can improve service quality, optimize telephone insurance processes, strengthen customer loyalty actions, fine-tune sales training, and improve products based on policyholder feedback such as cancellation reasons.
